question_entities.description: An array of special entities that appear in the poll question. It can be specified instead of _question\_parse\_mode_.

country_codes.description: An array of 0-12 two-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country codes indicating the countries from which users can vote in the poll; for channel chats only. Use “FT” as a country code to allow users with anonymous numbers to vote. If omitted or empty, then users from any country can participate in the poll.

correct_option_ids.description: An array of monotonically increasing 0-based identifiers of the correct answer options, required for polls in quiz mode

explanation_entities.description: An array of special entities that appear in the poll explanation. It can be specified instead of _explanation\_parse\_mode_.

description_entities.description: An array of special entities that appear in the poll description, which can be specified instead of _description\_parse\_mode_

reply_markup.description: Additional interface options. An object for an [inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-keyboards), [custom reply keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#keyboards), instructions to remove a reply keyboard or to force a reply from the user.
